title: Authentication and player identity
description: Server assigns seats by connection order with no identity verification. Add authentication so players have stable identity across reconnections. Minimum viable: token-based auth (JWT or similar) passed on WebSocket upgrade. Player can reconnect to their seat. Spectators remain anonymous.
close_reason: Token-based auth: 128-bit hex token generated on first join, returned in welcome, sent in hello for reconnection. Client stores token across reconnects. Spectators anonymous.
